text.en:
All previous Executive Orders, other presidential issuances and rules
and regulations which are inconsistent herewith are hereby modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 8
th day of June
Lord, two thousand and four.
, in the year of our
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
